_note: V0.5 detector: per-pixel color score (Conv1×1) → ReLU(score - score_floor) → AveragePool 5×5 → ReLU(density - density_floor) → soft-argmax. score_floor is the per-pixel orange threshold. density_floor is the spatial-coherence threshold — a pixel only votes if its 5×5 neighborhood is mostly orange too, which kills scattered noise. nn_conf_min is the host-side floor on published m_avg (NOT baked into the blob; applied in oak_driver_node). Edit via the GUI sliders or this file directly; rebuild with stewart_vision/scripts/build_v0_blob.py (conf-min skips the rebuild since it's host-side).
